items.question: Is Amatdda free?
items.answer: Yes. The core features are free. Some screens may show ads to help keep the service running.

items.question: What can I keep track of?
items.answer: To-dos and routines, birthdays and anniversaries, class timetables, car service and insurance, a gift log, and memos, all in one app. You can also see them in home screen widgets and on your lock screen.

items.question: Where is my data stored?
items.answer: What you enter is linked to your account and stored and synced securely on our servers. Sign in and it carries over when you switch devices.

items.question: What is the web version?
items.answer: A trial you can use before installing. Reminders and syncing across devices are available in the iOS and Android apps.
